text: Passport new application requires: Original CNIC or Smart CNIC, B-Form if under 18, passport-size photographs with white background, previous passport if any, and fee payment receipt. Process: 1) Fill online form at DGIP, 2) Pay fee at National Bank, 3) Book appointment, 4) Visit passport office for biometrics, 5) Verification and delivery.

Passport renewal requires: Original CNIC, previous passport, recent photographs, fee challan. Fee: Normal 36 pages PKR 3000 (10 years), Urgent PKR 5000. Delivery: Normal 10 days, Urgent 4 days. Visit DGIP passport office with appointment token.

Passport fee structure: 36-page normal PKR 3000, urgent PKR 5000, fast-track PKR 7500. 72-page normal PKR 5500, urgent PKR 8000. 100-page normal PKR 6000. Payment via National Bank or online via DGIP portal.

New CNIC (18+) requires: B-Form/CRC, parent/guardian CNIC copy, photographs, NADRA fee. Process: Visit NADRA Registration Center, biometric verification, form submission, token tracking. Fee: Normal PKR 1000 (30 days), Urgent PKR 2000 (7 days), Executive PKR 2500 (3 days).
CNIC renewal requires: Old CNIC, photographs, NADRA fee. If data change needed (name, address, marital status), bring supporting document like marriage certificate or domicile. Biometrics required.

CNIC modification (name correction, address update) requires: Old CNIC, supporting document (marriage certificate, domicile, affidavit), fee. Address change needs utility bill or rent agreement as address proof.

SECP Business Registration for Private Limited requires: CNIC of directors, company name availability check via SECP eServices, Memorandum & Articles of Association, registered address proof, SECP fee challan. Process: Name reservation → Incorporation filing → Certificate of Incorporation.
SECP fee: Name reservation PKR 200, Incorporation fee depends on authorized capital (e.g. PKR 100k capital ~ PKR 1800). Additional filing fees apply. Payment via SECP eServices challan at MCB/UBL.

RaahAI privacy: CNIC numbers are masked as XXXXX-XXXXXXX-X, not persisted beyond session. Uploaded documents are deleted after session. Always verify critical info via official DGIP, NADRA, SECP websites.
